title: 2003 Donruss #96 Manny Ramirez Boston Red Sox Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2003 Donruss baseball trading card featuring Manny Ramirez of the Boston Red Sox, card number 96. It is an original sports trading card from the Major League (MLB) set, manufactured by Donruss in the United States.
